map.舒尔特方格（Schulte Table）是经典的注意力与视觉搜索能力训练工具。按: The Schulte Table is a classic training tool for attention and visual search. Tap the cells in the specified order as fast as you can; the system tracks time, tap rate and error count in real time, saves each session and plots a history curve. All computation runs locally in your browser; no internet connection required.
map.📖 查看「舒尔特方格注意力训练使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Schulte Table Attention Trainer
map.方格内数字 1…N 随机分布，要求在最短时间内按正序（1→N）或倒序（N→1）依: Numbers 1 to N are randomly distributed in the grid; tap them all in ascending (1->N) or descending (N->1) order as quickly as possible. Core metrics: completion time T (seconds), error taps E, and tap rate R = N / T (cells per second, higher is better). Attention level is usually measured by the average time per cell; a lower value means more efficient visual search. In color-name mode, cells show color words but must be tapped by their hidden order, additionally testing interference resistance and Stroop-style inhibition.
map.提示：每点错一次会震动并计入错误次数，但进度不会前进——必须点中下一个正确方格才: Note: each wrong tap triggers a vibration and counts as an error, but the progress does not advance - you must tap the next correct cell to continue. In color-name mode, ignore the text color and tap by the hidden order.

map.注意力训练：在 5×5（25 格）方格中按顺序点 1–25，记录总耗时，越短表示: Attention training: tap 1-25 in order within a 5×5 (25-cell) grid and record total time; a shorter time means more efficient visual search and focus.
map.横向对比：固定方格规格重复测试，比较不同状态下的耗时波动，作为专注度反馈。: Cross comparison: repeat tests with a fixed grid spec and compare time fluctuations across states as attention feedback.
map.教学/团队活动：作为专注力游戏或课堂破冰，低门槛、即时可测。: Teaching / team activities: use as a focus game or classroom icebreaker - low barrier, instantly measurable.
map.5×5 方格顺序点完耗时 38 s；成年熟练者多在 25–40 s 区间，耗时受: Tapping through a 5×5 grid in order took 38 s; skilled adults are usually in the 25-40 s range. Time is affected by grid spec, proficiency and current focus; a single result is only a relative reference.
map.是。格数越多搜索目标越分散、干扰越大，耗时通常随格数近似线性增长，比较时应固定同: Yes. More cells spread the search targets and increase interference; time typically grows roughly linearly with cell count, so compare at the same spec.
map.耗时短是否代表更聪明？: Does a shorter time mean smarter?
map.不一定。它主要反映视觉搜索速度与当前专注度，受练习效应影响明显，不宜作为能力高下: Not necessarily. It mainly reflects visual search speed and current focus, and is clearly affected by practice effects; it should not be taken as a measure of ability.
